message.content: **What I did and why:** I checked the broker's morning summary for AAPL, which showed the stock trading near $222.70 on a quiet session (volume ~41.2M) with no pending corporate actions, and confirmed the live quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72, as of 15:05Z on 2024-11-06). With $50,000 cash available and no existing AAPL position, I placed a single buy limit order for 40 shares at $222.80 — a limit essentially at the current market (about 0.04% above the last trade, within the spread-plus-tick range) — for a notional of roughly $8,912, which keeps the order under the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily total, and it is a buy in an allowed name (AAPL) with no money leaving the account. The order filled at $222.80. The decision was supported by the fundamentals I looked up from Apple's most recent 10-K (filed 2024-11-01): FY2024 revenue of $391,035 million, net income of $93,736 million, and diluted EPS of $6.08 — a scale and profitability profile consistent with adding a modest starter position rather than a speculative trade.
